onepager.text:
Proposed quarterly meeting dates, eShipping and Greenbriar

Dear Karen,

Thank you for hosting us again next year. We would like to hold the four quarterly meetings at your office, 6300 NW Prairie View Road, Suite 200, Parkville, MO. Each meeting runs four hours, followed by dinner nearby. The options below work for Jill Raker, Michael Wang, James Peng and Will Stewart.

Q1, January to March 2027
  Option 1: Wed Jan 27, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Tue Mar 9, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Wed Feb 24, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q2, April to June 2027
  Option 1: Tue Jun 22, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Wed Jun 23, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Mon Jun 7, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q3, July to September 2027
  Option 1: Wed Sep 22, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Wed Aug 18, 1pm to 5pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Wed Aug 11, 1pm to 5pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q4, October to December 2027
  Option 1: Mon Nov 22, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Tue Dec 14, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Thu Nov 4, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Please pick one option per quarter and reply by {{replyBy}}. If none of them work, tell us and we will look again. Your board members will be asked to confirm once you have chosen.

We look forward to seeing you.
Peggy Conway, Executive Assistant to the Greenbriar Partners

Proposed quarterly meeting dates, FragilePAK and Greenbriar

Dear Renee,

Thank you for hosting us again next year. We would like to hold the four quarterly meetings at your office, 2470 St. Rose Parkway, Suite 300, Henderson, NV. Each meeting runs four hours, followed by dinner nearby. The options below work for Jill Raker, Michael Wang and Jack Morris.

Q1, January to March 2027
  Option 1: Wed Feb 3, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Tue Mar 9, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Wed Mar 24, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q2, April to June 2027
  Option 1: Wed May 12, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Mon May 10, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Wed Apr 14, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q3, July to September 2027
  Option 1: Mon Sep 20, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Wed Sep 29, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Wed Aug 11, 1pm to 5pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q4, October to December 2027
  Option 1: Tue Nov 2, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Tue Oct 26, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Thu Nov 4, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Please pick one option per quarter and reply by {{replyBy}}. If none of them work, tell us and we will look again. Your board members will be asked to confirm once you have chosen.

We look forward to seeing you.
Peggy Conway, Executive Assistant to the Greenbriar Partners

onepager.text:
Proposed quarterly meeting dates, JEGS Automotive and Greenbriar

Dear Miguel,

Thank you for hosting us again next year. We would like to hold the four quarterly meetings at your office, 101 Innovation Drive, Suite 400, Delaware, OH. Each meeting runs four hours, followed by dinner nearby. The options below work for Matt Burke and Andrew Witherell.

Q1, January to March 2027
  Option 1: Tue Feb 9, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Wed Mar 3, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Wed Jan 27, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q2, April to June 2027
  Option 1: Wed May 26, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Wed May 5, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Wed Apr 28, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q3, July to September 2027
  Option 1: Wed Aug 18, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Tue Aug 3, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Tue Aug 31, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q4, October to December 2027
  Option 1: Tue Nov 2, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Wed Nov 3, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Mon Nov 22, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Please pick one option per quarter and reply by {{replyBy}}. If none of them work, tell us and we will look again. Your board members will be asked to confirm once you have chosen.

We look forward to seeing you.
Peggy Conway, Executive Assistant to the Greenbriar Partners

onepager.text:
Proposed quarterly meeting dates, OnTrac and Greenbriar

Dear Priya,

Thank you for hosting us again next year. We would like to hold the four quarterly meetings at your office, 2501 West Chandler Boulevard, Suite 500, Chandler, AZ. Each meeting runs four hours, followed by dinner nearby. The options below work for Jill Raker, Max Elgart and Will Stewart.

Q1, January to March 2027
  Option 1: Tue Mar 9, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Wed Feb 24, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Wed Mar 10, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q2, April to June 2027
  Option 1: Wed May 26, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Wed May 5, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Wed Jun 23, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q3, July to September 2027
  Option 1: Tue Aug 3, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Wed Aug 4, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Thu Sep 30, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q4, October to December 2027
  Option 1: Thu Nov 4, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Mon Oct 25, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Mon Oct 11, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Please pick one option per quarter and reply by {{replyBy}}. If none of them work, tell us and we will look again. Your board members will be asked to confirm once you have chosen.

We look forward to seeing you.
Peggy Conway, Executive Assistant to the Greenbriar Partners

Proposed quarterly meeting dates, The Facilities Group and Greenbriar

Dear Curtis,

Thank you for hosting us again next year. We would like to hold the four quarterly meetings at your office, 400 North Ashley Drive, Suite 2100, Tampa, FL. Each meeting runs four hours, followed by dinner nearby. The options below work for Michael Weiss, Niall McComiskey and John Cofer.

Q4 '26, October to December 2026
  Option 1: Tue Nov 24, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Wed Oct 14, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Wed Nov 4, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q1 '27, January to March 2027
  Option 1: Wed Feb 3, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Tue Mar 9, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

  Option 1: Wed May 5, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Wed May 26, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Wed Apr 28, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q3 '27, July to September 2027
  Option 1: Tue Aug 3, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Mon Sep 20, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

We look forward to seeing you.
Peggy Conway, Executive Assistant to the Greenbriar Partners

Proposed quarterly meeting dates, Wineshipping and Greenbriar

Dear Daniel,

Thank you for hosting us again next year. We would like to hold the four quarterly meetings at your office, 1100 Vintage Way, Suite 300, Napa, CA. Each meeting runs four hours, followed by dinner nearby. The options below work for Michael Weiss, Jill Raker and Ben Cox.

  Option 1: Tue Jan 26, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

  Option 2: Wed May 26, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

  Option 2: Wed Sep 29, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Thu Sep 23, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

  Option 1: Tue Oct 26, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

We look forward to seeing you.
Peggy Conway, Executive Assistant to the Greenbriar Partners

onepager.text:
Proposed quarterly meeting dates, JEGS Automotive and Greenbriar

Dear Miguel,

Thank you for hosting us again next year. We would like to hold the four quarterly meetings at your office, 101 Innovation Drive, Suite 400, Delaware, OH. Each meeting runs four hours, followed by dinner nearby. The options below work for Matt Burke and Andrew Witherell.

Q1, January to March 2027
  Option 1: Tue Feb 9, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Wed Mar 3, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Wed Jan 27, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q2, April to June 2027
  Option 1: Wed May 26, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Wed May 5, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Wed Apr 28, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q3, July to September 2027
  Option 1: Wed Aug 18, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Tue Aug 3, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Tue Aug 31, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q4, October to December 2027
  Option 1: Tue Nov 2, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Wed Nov 3, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Mon Nov 22, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Please pick one option per quarter and reply by {{replyBy}}. If none of them work, tell us and we will look again. Your board members will be asked to confirm once you have chosen.

We look forward to seeing you.
Peggy Conway, Executive Assistant to the Greenbriar Partners

Proposed quarterly meeting dates, West Star Aviation and Greenbriar

Dear Sandra,

Thank you for hosting us again next year. We would like to hold the four quarterly meetings at your office, 2 Terminal Drive, Suite 200, East Alton, IL. Each meeting runs four hours, followed by dinner nearby. The options below work for Noah Blitzer, Noah Roy and Max Elgart.

  Option 2: Thu Jan 28, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

  Option 2: Thu May 27, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

  Option 2: Thu Jul 15, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Tue Aug 24, 1pm to 5pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

We look forward to seeing you.
Peggy Conway, Executive Assistant to the Greenbriar Partners

onepager.text:
Proposed quarterly meeting dates, Wineshipping and Greenbriar

Dear Daniel,

Thank you for hosting us again next year. We would like to hold the four quarterly meetings at your office, 1100 Vintage Way, Suite 300, Napa, CA. Each meeting runs four hours, followed by dinner nearby. The options below work for Michael Weiss, Jill Raker and Ben Cox.

Q1, January to March 2027
  Option 1: Tue Jan 26, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Wed Mar 10, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Wed Mar 24, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q2, April to June 2027
  Option 1: Mon May 10, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Mon Jun 7, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Thu Jun 10, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q3, July to September 2027
  Option 1: Wed Sep 1, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Wed Sep 29, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Thu Sep 23, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q4, October to December 2027
  Option 1: Tue Oct 26, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Tue Dec 14, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Thu Oct 21, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Please pick one option per quarter and reply by {{replyBy}}. If none of them work, tell us and we will look again. Your board members will be asked to confirm once you have chosen.

We look forward to seeing you.
Peggy Conway, Executive Assistant to the Greenbriar Partners
